newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - July 25.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - July 25.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Friday:
* On Thursday, the Dow ended up 28.57 points at a new high of 8,116.93, which surpassed Wednesday's milestone of 8,088.38, after a fast-paced recovery from a bout of profit-taking.
* Indonesian central bank governor Sudradjad Djiwandono said on Thursday further caution was needed despite a marginal improvement in rupiah rates.
* On Thursday, the Jakarta composite index ended 6.14 points, or 0.86 percent, lower at 712.05 points.
* On Friday, the rupiah was traded at 2,608.00/15.00 at 0205 GMT against an opening of 2,601.00/09.00.
* Bank Bira and Kalbe Farma after announcements of rises in their first-half net profits.
* Tin miner Timah on news that weak tin prices had hurt the firm's first half earnings.
* Property firm Lippo Cikarang after a strong debut on Thursday.
* Chemical firm Eterindo and alumunium manufacturer Alumindo both on news reports of talk of expected private placements.
* Pharmaceutical firm Darya Varia on reports it expected to post poor first half results.
